en: A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing multi‑story stone buildings lining a cobblestone street. Three men in dark suits and hats stand in the middle of the street with walking sticks. Shop signs in Swedish are visible on the buildings, including one reading "N. A. Nygrens Manufakturaffär." On the left is a gable wall filled with advertising text. The lower part of the image contains handwritten cursive text in Swedish along with printed captions indicating the street name and city.
